name: Freighter G-55-A
description: Freighter G-55-A was a freighter that was docked in Mirogana Spaceport in the city Mirogana on the Outer Rim Territories moon Toshara in 3 ABY. A coordinator announced over the speaker system at the spaceport that the freighter would be departing shortly for Mirial, a planet also located in the Outer Rim.
